settings.heading: Materials and care
settings.content:
Cotton body and clothes, wool felt shoes, carded wool stuffing, cotton embroidery thread.

Spot clean with a damp cloth and mild soap. Clothes can be hand washed in cool water and dried flat.

settings.heading: Shipping and returns
settings.content: Each doll is made to order and ready in 5 to 7 days. Unused dolls can be returned within 30 days.
